title: What It Actually Looks Like to Go Back to Your Hometown and Still Be the Man God Is Making
caption:
Going home for the holidays is a strange test. Same bedroom, same bar, same guys calling you by the old nickname. Within a day you can feel the old version of you pulling up a chair.

Go home as the man God is making. Love the old friends without the old plans. Be gentle with your family and let them see the change slowly. And pack your rhythms in the same bag as your clothes.

"Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewal of your mind." Romans 12:2

Send this to the brother flying home next week.
